notes: Drawn from the shipped v3.x screens (lib/screens + lib/widgets: HomePage/DetailPage/CommentsPage). The current main.dart points to an unfinished Instagram-style rewrite under lib/src (grey placeholder boxes, hard-coded 'name' / 'user.name'), which was not used. App font is Almarai via google_fonts; no local Almarai file, so SF Arabic is the stand-in. The white box on the details screen is the app's own (now empty) ad container. Relative times are English because the code calls timeago.format() without an Arabic locale. Comment authors show 'مجهول' as the code does for anonymous senders. Group/section/category names are sample data (they come from the API).
